subject.title: fix(auth-profiles): import legacy auth-profiles.json into SQLite store on load

question: Should normal runtime auth-profile loads be allowed to import retired secret-bearing `auth-profiles.json`, or must this recovery stay in doctor/startup migration code?
rationale: The PR fixes a real upgrade failure, but the implementation changes a compatibility- and credential-sensitive runtime boundary that current docs, tests, and repository policy keep in doctor/migration code.

options.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
options.body: Move the recovery into doctor or an explicit startup/update migration path and keep normal auth-store reads from consuming legacy JSON.

options.title: Approve Runtime Import
options.body: Accept this runtime fallback only with maintainer approval plus updated docs, tests, and security expectations for retired credential JSON.

options.title: Pause This Branch
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want a narrower replacement PR for startup/doctor recovery instead of runtime fallback.

recommendation.title: Keep Runtime SQLite-Only
recommendation.body: Move the recovery into doctor or an explicit startup/update migration path and keep normal auth-store reads from consuming legacy JSON.

likelyOwner.reason: The SQLite auth-store runtime boundary traces to the auth-profile SQLite refactor and current central store files.
